config_drift.description: Find runtime.env/runtime.local.env keys not represented in AppConfig or a documented legacy allowlist; detect duplicate env keys and contradictory defaults.

disabled_feature_parsing.description: Find config values parsed or validated even when the owning feature flag is disabled.

risk_pre_reconcile.description: Audit risk startup, pre-reconcile checks, RiskConfig parsing, disabled risk sub-engines, stale positions, reservation lifecycle, and exceptions before reconciliation starts.

reconciliation_state_machine.description: Trace order lifecycle states, ambiguous release logic, stale release paths, pending submission TTL behavior, retry behavior, and reservation cleanup.

market_data_policy.description: Verify REST snapshot vs WSS policy. REST-primary execution must not silently depend on WSS bootstrap when config says rest_snapshot is primary.

pending_tx_detection.description: Audit pending-transaction subscription code, calldata decoding, exchange address coverage, confidence transitions, dropped/reverted tx handling, and dedupe.

orderfilled_decoding.description: Verify Polymarket V2 OrderFilled maker/taker side logic, price computation, tokenId usage, and support for both CTF and Neg Risk exchanges.

idempotency.description: Look for duplicate order submission risk, weak dedupe keys, missing tx_hash + log_index usage, duplicate pending/mined event handling, and double-copy risk.

asyncio_websocket_lifecycle.description: Audit async tasks, cancellation, reconnect backoff, fire-and-forget tasks, queue backpressure, task leaks, missed awaits, and websocket stale connection detection.

db_consistency.description: Audit reservation tables, transaction boundaries, stale cleanup, race conditions around reconcile/execute, and consistency between local positions and venue truth.

secret_leakage.description: Find logs, reprs, debug outputs, exception messages, config.raw propagation, or test fixtures that could expose secrets.

strategy_copier_safety.description: If strategy-copy or env-mutation code exists, ensure dry-run by default, runtime.local.env-only writes, and no secret modification.

branch_merge_risk.description: Inspect open PRs and unmerged branches for overlapping edits, migration conflicts, stale architecture, raw env reads, and duplicate feature implementations.

live trading path ignores dry-run/paper mode
P1: pending tx treated as final truth
